decisions.statement: A widget names the component the widget is drawn in rather than the file's path.
A widget draws groups rather than readings.
A tile drawing what the tiles themselves are doing names no feed and no group.
A widget has the words the gallery prints and nothing the tile draws.
The name a placed tile is bound to cannot change without the tile falling off the phone.
A tile is granted forty to seventy reloads a day.
The reloads a tile is granted move with how often that tile is looked at.
Each placed tile is granted reloads of its own rather than reloads an app shares out.
A tile's entries cost that tile nothing and its reloads alone are counted.
A tile is not reloaded twice inside five minutes however near its next entry is.
A reload asked for while the app is in front is not counted against the grant.
A tile asked to reload is not promised a reload.
A push reloading a tile is rationed apart from that tile's own reloads.
Time is the only thing a tile redraws while nothing of the tile's is running.
A tile under WidgetKit developer mode reloads at a rate the phone will not grant.
Every tile of an app is reloaded when that app comes forward.
A widget's link names that widget in the link's fragment.
A widget carries how many taps that widget has taken.
A widget carries when that widget was last tapped.
The taps a widget has taken are carried outside the commit.
A tap is counted by reading the count and writing the count back.
A tap arriving while another tap is being recorded is lost.
Every tap a widget takes is counted.

definition: one tile a person places on a phone
